lines.say: Flip the Burj Khalifa upside down. That's eight hundred and twenty-eight meters.

lines.say: The deepest mine, Mponeng in South Africa, goes about four kilometers down.

lines.say: But the record is the Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia. Twelve thousand, two hundred and sixty-two meters.
lines.caption: 12,262 m
lines.cap: But the record is the Kola Superdeep Borehole in Russia. 12,262 meters.

lines.say: It's only twenty-three centimeters wide, and the rock down there hit one hundred and eighty degrees Celsius.

lines.say: Earth's center is six thousand, three hundred and seventy-one kilometers down. We got less than zero point two percent of the way.
